headline: Bank of Mongolia increases precious metal purchases to 8.9 tonnes since start of 2026
summary: The Central Bank of Mongolia increased its precious metal purchases from miners and individuals to 8.9 tonnes since the start of 2026. The purchases are aimed at replenishing state gold and foreign exchange reserves.
why: Central bank gold buying supports reserve diversification and adds steady demand to the global gold market.
